gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-fustat: Balsamiq Sans draws every stroke like a channel cut through stencil board. Fustat, a plain sans of bent-tube lines with a wide gap where the c ends, takes over for the reading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gantari: Balsamiq Sans holds one constant weight, like a stencil-cut channel with no pinched curves. And Gantari handles the talking, wire-bent and approachable, with wide c apertures, while the heading handles the shouting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-he: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew reads openly, its uncrowded s and c mouths giving the sans-serif lines a contemporary, approachable feel. Balsamiq Sans brings blunt, untapered punch above while the body stays easy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped draws curves that refuse to close. Balsamiq Sans, every stroke ending blunt at a measured width, feels loud and chunky beside that clean, restrained sans.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-inclusive-sans: Loud on top, tidy below: Balsamiq Sans over Inclusive Sans. The heading does bold, expressive display work, while the sans-serif body keeps its round letters open-ended and its rims matching the stems.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-jura: Bold, stencil-cut channels of letter lead the way in Balsamiq Sans. Jura, a plain sans of bent-wire strokes and s curves opening wide at both ends, handles the text underneath.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-k2d: Balsamiq Sans brings bold, expressive lettering with no pinched curves. K2D, a sans with tube-like strokes and c terminals hanging far from the bowl, should read smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kantumruy-pro: Bold lettering up top, friendly text below: Balsamiq Sans and Kantumruy Pro. What stands out is the sans-serif body's e, opening clearly to the right, beside heading strokes that never pinch.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kodchasan: Stencil-bold and unpinched, that is Balsamiq Sans doing the heading work. Kodchasan, a sans with open terminals and no calligraphic thinning, should keep paragraphs moving smoothly line after line, with nothing to snag on.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-livvic: Expressive and blunt, Balsamiq Sans holds a constant weight through every channel-like stroke. Livvic, a plain sans, stays approachable beneath it, its c opening generously and its curves carrying no stress.
